title: UPDATE: UNM
description: We are offering the decryption key for the remaining of locked devices for free (ONLY for the hospital sector) we did not know that it was running machines related to assisting patients in real-time, (we would keep it locked if it was appointments, patient information + research data only), we are still going to keep the data, but we will provide the decryption key for the hospital sector only. Feel free to contact us on Session. To any patient that was affected, please provide us proof, and we will pay you up to $2500 each for the inconvenience. We are sorry once again. We have morals and we have a heart, we are not villains, but we will still continue to hold companies responsible for bad security leading to the compromise of any customer data. That's the whole reason why we came about and we plan to keep it that way.
